key_audit_matters: Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern
qualifications_or_emphasis: Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern: The Company has significant accumulated losses and has incurred losses of Rs. 13.87 lakhs during the current year and Rs. 12.83 lakhs in previous year. The Company's net worth is fully eroded and the current liabilities exceed its current assets by Rs. 438.19 lakhs as at March 31, 2026. These conditions raise a doubt regarding the Company's ability to continue as a going concern. However, the financial statements have been prepared on a going concern basis in view of the financial support from the Promoter Group to meet its financial obligations as and when they fall due.

Material uncertainty related to going concern: significant accumulated losses, net worth fully eroded, current liabilities exceed current assets by Rs. 438.19 lakhs; financial statements prepared on going concern basis based on promoter group financial support letter
